cards.text: New campsite, friend. In the first month, the whole congregation of Israel comes into the Wilderness of Zin and stays in Kadesh. And there, Moses' family takes a hit.

cards.question: While Israel stays at Kadesh, someone from Moses' family dies there. Who is it?

cards.text: Miriam, the sister of Moses and Aaron (Numbers 26:59), is buried there at Kadesh. Then the camp runs into the one problem a wilderness just LOVES to hand you.

cards.question: At Kadesh, there is no ___ for the congregation.
With no water at Kadesh, the congregation gathers to pray alongside Moses and Aaron.

cards.text: The people quarrel with Moses and say, "If only we had perished with our brothers before the LORD!" Friend, I said lines like that my first year in the junk drawer, out loud, to a rubber band.

cards.question: The people ask Moses why he brought the LORD's assembly into this wilderness for them and their livestock to ___ there.
Next the people ask Moses why he led them up out of ___ to this wretched place.

cards.text: Then they list what this place is not: not a place of grain, figs, vines or pomegranates, "and there is no water to drink!" Moses and Aaron leave the assembly, go to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting and fall facedown.

cards.question: Moses and Aaron are facedown at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting. What appears to them?

cards.text: Then the LORD speaks to Moses: take the staff and assemble the congregation. A staff, a crowd and a rock, and that's the whole recipe.

cards.question: The LORD tells Moses and Aaron to do something to the rock while the congregation watches, and it will pour out its water. What is it?

cards.text: So Moses takes the staff from the LORD's presence, just as he had been commanded. He and Aaron gather the assembly in front of the rock, and Moses starts talking.

cards.question: In front of the rock, Moses asks the assembly, "must we bring you water out of this rock?" But first, what does Moses call them?
Then Moses raises his hand and ___ the rock ___ with his staff.
After Moses strikes the rock, a great amount of water gushes out, and the congregation and their livestock are able to drink.

cards.text: Water's gushing, everybody's drinking. Then the LORD speaks to Moses and Aaron, and it is NOT a thank-you note.

cards.question: The LORD tells Moses and Aaron what they did not do at the rock. What was it?

answers.text: Trust Him to show His holiness
Thank Him in front of the people
Ask Him which rock to use

cards.question: Even after the rock, the LORD says Moses and Aaron will still be the ones who bring the assembly into the land He has given them.

cards.text: "These were the waters of Meribah, where the Israelites quarreled with the LORD, and He showed His holiness among them." A thirsty camp, a rock and a staff, and the place gets a name of its own.

findings.problem: The question says Miriam is 'someone from Moses' family.' Numbers 20:1 doesn't say that; it comes from Numbers 26:59. Card 1 hints at it too ('Moses' family takes a hit'), and neither card carries a reference. The reference only shows up later on card 3.

rule.text: **References.** Every Bible fact he states carries its reference.

findings.problem: The card uses Numbers 26:59 (Miriam is the sister of Moses and Aaron), but its verses field cites only Numbers 20:1-2.

rule.text: **Cite exactly what the card uses.** Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.

findings.problem: The joke invents a new moment in Papa Dorin's drawer backstory: saying 'if only I had perished' lines out loud to a rubber band in his first year. Jokes may only invent small moments around his bakery. They can't add to the backstory.

rule.text: His backstory, family, bakery and mission are the Dorinverse story in this file. He can talk about them freely, but never adds anything new to them. His jokes can make up small moments and habits around his bakery.

findings.problem: 'A staff, a crowd and a rock, and that's the whole recipe' reads as a pleasant aside, not a real laugh. Apart from card 6, the walkthrough has almost no laugh-out-loud moments.

rule.text: If a line reads like a nice dad being pleasant, push it further.

findings.problem: After quoting verse 13, the card's last line ('A thirsty camp, a rock and a staff, and the place gets a name of its own') goes back over earlier moments instead of moving the passage forward. It also repeats the staff/rock list from card 11.
